title: Tang Tang
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1000006878 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)
gbaverify naming-buster run: level timer 4 -> 70 -> 37 matched the HUD counter

widgets.text:
Place and break blocks to make paths; reach the exit door
Lives; health

Platform jumping; puzzles
Place and break blocks to build paths; cannonballs and pickups help in some levels

Some levels switch into a boss mode; cannonballs and blocks are the tools
Bosses at world ends

Pickups
Rings and bolts are collected in levels (counted on screen)

Hidden items
Hidden pickups need blocks placed to reach them

Worlds cleared
Worlds in order; high scores are kept
High scores are saved with a name entry

notes: most RA notes are marked EU; RA's US lives byte 0x02001430 read 0 with 2 lives on the HUD, so it is not used. The level timer (HUD 004 -> 070 -> 037) was found by own search at 0x02003920
